messages:
Ravi Kapoor: idea — lightweight launch for DevSnack: three tiny tutorials + one refapp. focus: quick wins for devs and a clear benchmark narrative. :sparkles:
Lena Ortiz: nice. what's "tiny" here? 10–12 min reads? single-file examples?
Ravi Kapoor: yes — 1) quickstart (5 min), 2) cost/latency tuning (8 min), 3) rollout checklist (5 min). all copy-paste ready. refapp shows routing + caching in one endpoint.
Maya L.: i'll take quickstart + rollout checklist. Owen, can you scaffold the refapp?
Owen B.: yep. small node/python microservice with two routes: /generate -> hosted, /generate?local=1 -> local fallback. will include Dockerfile and a tiny compose for local dev.
Ravi Kapoor: bench narrative: show a reproducible 3-run median for token latency and cost per 1k tokens. avoid flashy multipliers unless defensible. Lena can you draft the bench section?
Lena Ortiz: on it. will include commands and exact env vars. sample run: 
```
./bench.sh --model xr-lite --seq 256 --runs 3 --seed 7
```
OpsBot: Reminder: add UTM params utm_source=devsnack&utm_campaign=devsnack_launch to all public links.
Maya L.: inbound flow: blog CTA -> HubSpot list `devsnack_launch`, add tag `devsnack_trial`. nurture: 3 emails (how-to, bench tips, invite to office hours).
Owen B.: repo layout plan: `/tutorials/01-quickstart`, `/tutorials/02-cost`, `/tutorials/03-rollout`, `/refapp/` with `docker/` and `deploy.md`. pushing branch Thursday.
Ravi Kapoor: webinar? optional office hours 1 week after. short 30-min slot: 15 demo, 10 bench & tips, 5 Q&A. Maya lead demo, Lena bench talk.
Lena Ortiz: timeline: drafts by Fri EOD, bench CSVs Mon AM, blog copy Mon noon, socials Tue, launch Wed. tight but doable.
Maya L.: i can get quickstart up by Fri. will include a Binder link and a one-command docker local run.
Owen B.: will include a `results/` folder in the repo with raw CSV + a small reproducibility README.
Ravi Kapoor: social assets: 1 hero screenshot, 2 10s GIFs (hosted + local), 3 tweet captions. Maya can mock the hero.
Maya L.: will export GIFs and a square image for socials.
OpsBot: Action created: content/launch/devsnack checklist (owner: Ravi Kapoor).
Lena Ortiz: metrics to track: docs views, repo clones, tutorial runs (Binder/dockers), and HubSpot conversions. I'll list event names in the bench README.
Ravi Kapoor: final: keep language practical and example-first. no lofty promises. assign publish ops to Maya, content sync to Lena, refapp code to Owen.
Maya L.: taking publish ops. will create scheduled PR and HubSpot assets.
Owen B.: branch pushed tonight, will ping when CI bench completes.
Lena Ortiz: will avoid any "2x" claims unless raw data supports it.
Ravi Kapoor: thanks team. i'll convert to Notion checklist and share calendar invite once dates lock. :thumbsup:
